method: Batch 91 (mobrec91): the batch 90 b90mr harness (a counting World.rand, row element 11) with: dead-flight (a zombie knocks the probe player up and it dies in flight; EntityPlayerMP.onUpdateEntity keeps running on the dead copy), dead-spider/silverfish/giant/zombie (the player at health 0 beside legacy and AI mobs: World.getClosestPlayer, getClosestVulnerablePlayer, the look target until isDead), slime-* and magma-* (a slime of size 2 and 1, a magma cube of size 2 and 4 against the real-health player), golem-* (an iron golem against a slime, magma cube, silverfish, witch, pigman and giant, and hurt by the player). Row target of a silverfish, giant and pigman is entityToAttack (td.bT). Types: i slime 2, j slime 1, l magma cube 2, u magma cube 4. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
